channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Combination therapy improves survival in bladder cancer
item.description: In a phase 3 trial, perioperative enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab improved survival in muscle-invasive bladder cancer.

item.title: Higher fitness levels linked to lower mortality risk
item.description: Higher objectively measured physical fitness was associated with progressively lower all-cause mortality across multiple domains.

item.title: Many patients may not fully understand lab results via portals
item.description: A large cross-sectional study found that patients viewing lab results through portals may not fully comprehend them.

item.title: FDA approves first mRNA influenza vaccine
item.description: The FLUENT trial showed 26.6% relative efficacy over a standard-dose comparator in adults 50+, leading to FDA approval.
